names.description: FoodKeeper product ID → display name (the phrase people search for).

slugs.description: FoodKeeper product ID → slug, when the derived slug is wrong.

aliases.description: slug → extra search terms for the site search.

pairs.description: Merge a second FoodKeeper product into a page as the toggle's second state.

patches.description: FoodKeeper ID → replacement states. Must state _why and carry extraSource.

custom.description: Foods FoodKeeper does not cover. Each needs a named public source.

content.description: slug → hand-written copy that replaces generated copy (notes, quote, methods, signs, freezeSteps, leftOut, dates, store, similar, faq, portion).
